name: app-black-and-white-crypto-wallet-concept-with-blue-tint-chart-and-checker-analytics
title: Black-Outlined Crypto Wallet Concept
whatItIs: Three phones with thick black bezels on light grey: a white wallet with a big balance, action tiles and asset cards with sparklines and a black Market and Wallet pill; a periwinkle asset page with a jagged line chart, range pills, a staking banner and Buy and Sell buttons; and an Analytics page with a weekday grid of black and hatched cells.
whatItMeans: Heavy black outlines and a single periwinkle screen give a graphic, poster-like clarity, and the checker grid makes analytics playful.
techniques: Thick black outlines on the devices and controls
One periwinkle screen among white ones
Weekday grid cells with black and hatched fills

vocabulary.definition: A cell filled with diagonal lines to mark a special state.
A design exploration not tied to a live product.
A thick line used as the device frame.
